spans.s: COACH: रथः: v. Carriage, chariot.
COACH-MAN: सारथिः: v. Charioteer.
COADJUTOR: सहायः: v. Assistant.
COAGULATION: expr. by verb.

COAL:
(1) अङ्गार, (=charcoal);
(2) अङ्गाराश्मन्
(m.)
or
अङ्गारमृत्तिका।
C.-heaver:
अङ्गारवाहकः (?).
C.-pit:
अङ्गारभूमिः (?).
COALESCE: v. To unite, combine.
COALITION: संयोगः: v. Communion, alliance.

COARSE:
I Not fine: स्थूलः (ला, लं), c. cloth
स्थलवस्त्रम्, P.; body is of two kinds, c. and fine: []
द्विविधं शरीरं स्थूलं सूक्ष्मं च, S. iv. 3.
II Rude,
unpolished, mean: q. v.
COARSELY: v. Rudely, impolitely, meanly.

COARSENESS:
I Lit.:
(1) स्थूलता;
(2) स्थौल्यम्।
II Rudeness; vulgarity: q. v.

COAST (subs.): तीरम्, whether he reached the c.
तीरमगमद्वा, D.: v. Shore. Ph.:
c.-line
वेला, R.
xiii. 15.; “the c. is clear (i. e. danger is
over): निष्कण्टका भूमिः (?).

COAST (v. i.): उपकूलं पोतं वाहयति
or
पोतेन गच्छति (?).

COASTING (adj.): Ph.: c. vessel (i. e. a coaster)
*उपकूलपोतः,
c. -trade:
*उपकूलवाणिज्यम्।

COAT (subs.): An article of dress: *कोटभ्।
II A covering: q. v.
(1) आवरणम्, c. s. of mail:
देहावरणानि, Ki.: v. Armour;
(2) पटलम् (of the
eye). Ph.:
c. of arms:
*चोलचिह्नम्।
COAT (v.): v. To cover, overlay.

COATING (subs.): v. Covering, coat (II). C.
(of a paint): लेपः, K.
COAX (v.): v. To wheedle, fondle, soothe.
COAXING (subs.): v. Coaxingly.

COAXINGLY: i. e. by c.:
(1) प्रियशतमधुराभिर्वाग्भिः
K.;
(2) चाटूक्तिभिः
or
चाटुशतैः (by flattery),
H.;
(3) अभ्यर्थनाभिः (begging), K.
